page.layout: One engraved portrait page: a framed oval portrait of a man in a full wig and ornate robe, with an armoured figure at the left and a seated female figure at the right, and a cartouche banner at the bottom carrying the printed inscription. No text outside the cartouche.

main_text.l: S. R. I. ARCHI-CAMERARIUS ac PRINCEPS ELECTOR &c &c &c

page.notes: The "S. R. I." in the third line and the "Ecclesiaeque" line are partly obscured by the cartouche folds and are doubtful; "Schonebeck" is read as "Schonebek" with uncertainty. The "&c" repetitions are copied as far as legible. The engraving itself (portrait, armoured figure with shield, seated allegorical female figure with scales, dragon at the base) is described here and not transcribed.
